newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end lower, spreads widen.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end lower, spreads widen.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed lower after a day of profit taking in sympathy with Spanish government bonds and spreads under 10-year Bonos widened to nearly 20 basis points (bp), dealers said.
"Futures and cash closed lower with Spain, but spreads widened with our market showing a better performance," said a fixed rate director.
Another said: "We need to know where Bonos are going. If Spain falls further, we will follow, but our fall will be more limited because there is a shortage of liquidity, especially in 10-year paper."
The money market closed steady. Overnight and tomorrow/next stood at 7.05/7.10 percent, similar to the opening.
